name: @pipeworx/mcp-data-maryland

tools.name: datasets
tools.description: Search the Maryland Open Data catalog of open datasets by keyword. Returns each dataset's resource_id, name, description, category and update date — pass the resource_id to query/metadata.

tools.name: query
tools.description: Run a Socrata SoQL query against a Maryland Open Data dataset by resource_id (e.g. "2ir4-626w"). Filter with where/select/group/order (SoQL clauses, without the leading $) plus limit/offset. Returns matching rows as JSON.

tools.name: metadata
tools.description: Get a Maryland Open Data dataset's schema + metadata (columns, types, row count, category, last-updated) by resource_id, e.g. "2ir4-626w".

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-data-maryland forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the data-maryland pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
